nodes.source_text: Peng et al. anchored Ru single atoms onto low-crystallinity nickel hydroxide... creating a locally acidic microenvironment in an alkaline medium. This strategy broke the pH dependence of HER activity.
This allowed the catalyst to exhibit acid-like HER activity in neutral media, achieving a 10mAcm⁻² current density with an overpotential of only 20mV and a Tafel slope as low as 28mVdec⁻¹.
The synergistic RuSeₓ-RuNC catalyst demonstrated excellent performance in neutral HER, with an overpotential of only 29mV at 10mA cm⁻²
